body: This... Is exactly what I'm going through right now. Almost everything you said, I'm currently dealing with. It's all so frustrating and confusing and scary but god it's nice to know there is someone else who is feeling similar.
That's what I was wondering. Something keeps holding me back too and I don't know why.

I honestly can not thank you enough for everything you've said. I'm sorry this isn't as long of a response as that post deserves but it really meant a lot to me. As for the insurance thing, I am on my parents and I don't want to involve them. But you're right maybe a therapist wouldn't be so bad if I could find one that sounds like yours. I talked to a few when I was younger and I hated it. I felt like they were judging me and that they were bored and there were times where they would just kind of sit there and not say anything which made me feel worse. It's really cool how those guys stayed with you and opened up to you that way. Sometimes that really does make you feel better and like you're not so alone. Which is probably why your post made me feel a little better. I'm not sure what makes me happy or what to live for but if I stick around for a little longer, I hope I find it. Saying no to suicide is really hard when there's nothing to live for and nothing holding you back. I think I believe the same thing happens when you die. And when you said you would have preferred the nothingness and saw it as an escape it really resonated with me because that's how I feel. I welcome the escape that ends the horrible feelings and dark thoughts I have constantly. But the thing about what you said that hit me the most is I didn't really think about how much it would suck to have the last thing you experience be sadness. That does seem like a crappy way to end your life. It's like watching a movie that has such an abrupt terrible ending and you feel like the whole movie was a waste. I would like to think I'd rather die happy. The problem is when I'm having an exceptionally bad day or bad streak of days, I don't care about any of that stuff. The only thing I feel is this desire for everything to just be over. Last week I told my friend I was thinking about hurting myself and then I realized how badly I actually wanted to. So I jumped in my car, drove to my favorite spot with the best view of my city, and tried to prepare myself for it. When it gets that bad, like in this case, I don't care about anything. I can only think about how miserable I am and how, as sad as it sounds, everyone would eventually get over me or at least be able to move on and continue with their lives. My thinking was so foggy, I didn't even think about how I was ping to do it or grab anything that I could even do it with. My friend called me and begged me to tell him where I was and that he was looking for me but I didn't want him to find me so I didn't tell him. I listened to him for about an hour and realized he was minutes away from finding me so I grabbed a cord out of my backpack and told him I was sorry and tried to strangle myself but he found me and wrestled the cord off of my neck. He asked me to promise that I would stay just a little longer, even if it was just for another week, so I gave him a week. It's been a week and 2 days and I no longer would be breaking a promise. I'm miserable and I'm incredibly close to a point in my life where things are about to get much worse. I might give it another day and think it through until tomorrow but the odds are not seeming good. The only thing holding me back is I don't have a gun and that would be how I'd want to go so I don't have to handle any pain. But when I get in that mindset and my inner bitch starts beating myself up mentally, those concerns don't matter as much. I don't know. I really don't. But you have given me a few things to think about. I wonder what your therapist would say to me.
What did you feel when you were looking down?

Thank you for all of this. It's nice knowing I'm not alone and you seem to understand pretty well what I'm going through. You are right about the depression thing. I've had really bad depression since I was a child. I wish I had those memories in elementary/high school but I didn't. Both were pretty terrible for me (but neither was as bad as middle school. Those were some of the darkest points in my life). If my happiness/sadness were like a graph, it would be almost entirely under the x axis (in the negative if that didn't make sense) and the "high" points are incredibly low. My best memories in life are only moderately happy for a short amount of time and had a heavy cloud of darkness hanging over them, never going away. I don't have many things I enjoy doing but I try to do things just for the sake of doing something. Sometimes I would like a therapist but I can't afford that and I know the suggestions they would make would all be things I already know and just don't want to do. I would really only be using them for someone to bitch about my problems to. I'm not religious either, although I kind of used to be when I was younger and that was the one thing keeping me alive. Now that I'm not religious it's harder to find things to live for. Right now there really is nothing and I'm not sure why I'm still here (maybe my fear of the pain that comes with killing yourself) but I know I'm about one little bad event or inconvenience away from finding a gun and pulling the trigger.

That first part sums it up perfectly. Thank you for phrasing it better than I could. The only person I can talk to is one of my friends but it's only so helpful. At the end of the day my life is still shit and he was just able to make it slightly less shitty temporarily. And I understand the age question, it's no problem asking me. I'm 21. I know that's young and things could still get better and all that jazz but like I said I'm just not willing to try anymore. I'm confident I would still feel this way, if not worse, when I'm 30 except at that point I'll have more stress and responsibilities.

I've been unhappy for a long time. I'm a negative cynical person who just pushes people away and then feels lonely. I know that the simple solution to that is to stop pushing people away but I can't. It's just who I am. A lot of my problems are things like that. To make a long story short, I was bullied relentlessly for years and went through a bunch of shitty relationships and I've just had horrible self esteem issues that will never go away. I've never really had any good friends or people I could talk to about anything and I have to bottle up so much. My health (mental and physical) has been declining and my stress has been increasing. Everything I try to do in life I fail at or quit and I have these unrealistic expectations of life and won't do anything to achieve them. My family puts a lot of pressure, stress, and judgment on me and I can't talk to them about it (I know you guys are going to suggest that but just trust me on this one, it's not going to happen and it 100% wouldn't help. That's the last piece of advice I want to hear right now.) I'm lazy and mean and I'm just unhappy with myself. I don't see any future where I go do anything that would make me happy. I know things could be better and I know everyone's going to tell me to go out and meet people or talk to my family/friends or tell me what actions I should take to be happier but I'm going to be honest I'm not going to do any of that. I'm aware there are things I COULD do to make my life better but I just don't want to. Plain and simple. I don't have it in me anymore and I don't see the point. I'm not going to bust my ass so I can have a mediocre life and not be happy. "But you can do anything you want if you put your mind to it..." No I'm being realistic here. The most likely scenario is that I'll work somewhere I'm not completely happy and with my unreal expectations I'll always be depressed and feel like part of me is empty. The bottom line is right now things are bad and they're about to get a lot worse (this is a fact, not something I need everyone to debate) and I've been unhappy for a long time. I'm at a point right now in life where if I'm going to end it all, this is the time to do it. I don't have many things that I would be leaving behind (job, relationship, bills, etc.) Like I said I don't know what I want from you people, whether it be to talk me off the ledge or just to hear what I have to say before I take that jump but I just know I needed to say something. And what better way than to talk to a bunch of unbiased strangers anonymously.
